product_brief: Certificate lifecycle management and PKI platform; release 9.3 adds quantum-safe certificate issuance (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS) with HSM support.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-DSA with HSM integration (select HSMs via REST API), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) with 12 parameter sets, LMS certificates, hybrid CAs (EJBCA 9.3)
pqc_capability_description: EJBCA 9.3 supports quantum-safe certificate issuance: ML-DSA with select HSMs (REST API based integration, e.g., Securosys, Fortanix), SLH-DSA per FIPS 205 (12 parameter sets, soft CryptoToken), LMS certificates, hybrid CA creation via CLI. P11NG Crypto Token is prepared for PKCS#11 quantum-safe integration. Bouncy Castle upgraded to 1.80.
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS, RSA (RSA-OAEP, RSA PKCS1.5), EC (elliptic curve), Triple DES (DES-EDE3-CBC), SHA1PRNG (replaced)
key_management_model: HSM-backed (PKCS#11 via P11NG Crypto Token, and REST API based HSM integration) plus soft crypto tokens; key archival/recovery with RSA-OAEP, key import/migration from external CAs, key compromise blocklist; fails if HSM contains extractable private keys.
architecture_type: On-premises/deployable PKI server (Java-based; Helm chart, Docker, Azure SQL deployments); HSM-integrated
primary_platforms: Java 21 (minimum 21.0.5), Azure (Azure SQL with Workload Identity), Helm/Kubernetes, Docker, JBoss
pqc_roadmap_details: P11NG Crypto Token is prepared for PKCS#11-based integration for quantum-safe algorithms; HSMs supporting quantum-safe algorithms use REST API integration in 9.3. No further timelines stated.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Bouncy Castle 1.80 dependency; library upgrades noted (Apache CXF 4.0.6+, PrimeFaces 15.0.1+, jsch 0.2.24)
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Soft migration of existing PKCS#11 Crypto Tokens to P11NG via an environment variable; upgrade notes and paths referenced; removal of User Data Sources and ca.doPermitExtractablePrivateKeys property; Java 21 may leave orphaned certificates in HSM for pre-9.3 keys.

evidence.PQC Support: Starting with EJBCA 9.3, the quantum-safe algorithm ML-DSA can be used with HSM integration for select HSMs.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Support for the NIST approved quantum-safe algorithm SLH-DSA as specified in FIPS 205 has been added. The algorithm can be used with 12 different parameter sets
evidence.Latest Version: These release notes cover new features and improvements implemented in EJBCA 9.3.0, EJBCA 9.3.1, and EJBCA 9.3.2
evidence.Crypto Primitives: ECA-11574 Change key recovery encryption algorithm to RSA-OAEP instead of RSA PKCS1.5
evidence.Signature Schemes: ECA-12579 Add support for LMS certificates
evidence.PQC Roadmap Details: the P11NG Crypto Token enables use of additional functionality and is prepared for PKCS#11-based integration for quantum-safe algorithms.
